messages:
alisa: Heads up — planning a small track at next week's ISV/tooling summit to align LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter messaging + cloud marketplace joint listing + HW partner preflight. Need owners and announcement windows.
marco: Can we split into three lanes? 1) adapter compat & test harness, 2) marketplace listing assets, 3) HW perf blurb + bench numbers.
jen: I can own marketplace assets. Need final logos, pricing tier text, and a 1-sentence blurb for co-marketing.
eli: I'll own the adapter test harness. Quick Q: do we require LangChain runner + LlamaIndex indexer e2e? That changes infra sandbox setup.
tom: HW partner (SigmaGPU) asked for sample workloads and latency SLOs. We should pin a quant/precision spec and target hardware.
partner_ops: @alisa re: timeline — SigmaGPU asked for signoff by Fri to ship demo units. If we miss that, they want to delay the joint demo by a week.
alisa: Prefer not to delay public launch. Proposal: soft-preview on marketplace Monday, full joint announce Thursday after partners greenlight.
marco: Also need eng checklist: API contract, auth flows, rate limits, and an adapter conformance test. I'll drop a gist with the checklist.
jen: For marketplace assets — will need a short technical verification statement. Suggest: "Verified integration with Redwood Inference, validated for 1k req/min burst". Also need partner logo + 20–30 word blurb.
eli: For adapter harness, sample run command: ```bash ./run_integration_test --model gptq-6b --seq 1024 --batch 8``` We'll capture KV cache hit rates and end-to-end latency.
tom: Sigma's ask: p95/p99 latency targets. They want p99 <150ms on 512 tokens in dedicated mode. Can infra meet that?
alisa: @sre-bot can you run a capacity check against those numbers for both hosted and dedicated pools? Please post results here.
sre-bot: Got it — scheduling load job now. Will post summary in-thread by EOD.
partner_ops: Marketing requested co-brand brief. @jen do you have brand guidelines or should I pull from the partner portal?
jen: Pull from partner portal, I'll add the marketplace copy + one partner quote. Need partner quote from Sigma by Wed.
eli: Heads-up: LangChain runner API moved to v0.9 last week — adapter needs a small shim. @marco can we schedule a 2-day dev patch?
marco: Yep, plan a 2-day patch window. I'll coordinate with Eli to avoid breaking canary.
tom: Suggest a canary rollout plan for the adapter: 5% -> monitor errors for 24h -> 25% -> 100%. Also run smoke tests against Sigma hardware.
alisa: Owners: Jen = marketplace + co-marketing; Eli = adapter harness & shim; Marco = API contract & canary; Tom = HW liaison; Partner_ops = partner sync & quotes; Alisa = announce owner.
jen: :thumbsup: I'll draft the marketplace page and co-marketing brief tomorrow morning.
eli: I'll post integration test results here once the harness finishes.
sre-bot: Capacity run complete. Hosted pool simulated 1k RPS at 512 tokens: p99 = 120ms. Dedicated pool p99 = 95ms. Attaching result link: https://internal.redwood/results/1745554321 (placeholder).
tom: Nice — those numbers look good. Can Sigma confirm quote + approve copy? @partner_ops to chase.
partner_ops: On it — pinged Sigma. Will share partner quote and logo by 5pm PT today.
alisa: Great. Let's reconvene in this thread for final checks. If nothing blocks by Wed EOD, target announce Thursday. :raised_hands:
